motivation.zh: 在与 Li 定理 6、7 相同窗长上保留平方根加数限制，分别研究漏点数与完全未命中的窗口。
motivation.en: Keep the square-root constraint at the window scales of Li's Theorems 6 and 7 and study the exception count and entirely missed windows separately.

tasks.statement: let W := fun y : ℕ => Nat.floor ((y : ℝ) ^ ((13 : ℝ) / 225)); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2 * Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let R := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∃ C δ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W y ≤ 2 * X → (((Finset.Icc y (y + W y)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ R X n = 0)).card : ℝ) ≤ C * ((W y : ℝ) + 1) * (X : ℝ) ^ (-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 短窗内平方根量级加数的漏点数有幂次节省
plain_statement.en: Power-saving exceptional set with a square-root-sized summand in every short window

brief.zh: 待证。对充分大的 X，每个完整落在 [X,2X] 的闭窗 [y,y+⌊y^(13/225)⌋] 中，不能写成 p+q 且 ⌊√X⌋≤p≤2⌊√X⌋ 的偶数至多为 C(⌊y^(13/225)⌋+1)X^(-δ) 个。p、q 都是素数。尝试为实际受限计数构造带奇异级数的正主项，并用逐窗局部均方误差和已证漏点能量引理计数。Li 定理 6 在同窗给出无加数限制的密度趋一结论。本题同时限制加数并要求幂次节省。可引用全站已核验的 Lean 模块；见 https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json。
brief.en: Open. For large X, every closed window [y,y+floor(y^(13/225))] inside [X,2X] has at most C(floor(y^(13/225))+1)X^(-δ) even integers without a prime pair p+q with floor(sqrt X) ≤ p ≤ 2 floor(sqrt X). Try a positive singular-series main term and a uniform local mean-square error to which the verified exception-energy lemma applies. Li's Theorem 6 gives density one on the same window with unrestricted summands. This target adds a summand constraint and a power saving. You may import verified Lean modules listed at https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json.

tasks.statement: let W := fun y : ℕ => Nat.floor ((y : ℝ) ^ ((26 : ℝ) / 1075)); ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W y ≤ 2 * X → ∃ n : ℕ, y ≤ n ∧ n ≤ y + W y ∧ Even n ∧ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Nat.sqrt X ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 * Nat.sqrt X ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 每个超短窗都有一个带平方根量级素数加数的哥德巴赫数
plain_statement.en: A Goldbach hit with a square-root-sized prime in every ultra-short window

brief.zh: 待证。对充分大的 X，每个完整落在 [X,2X] 的闭窗 [y,y+⌊y^(26/1075)⌋] 中，至少一个偶数能写成两个素数之和，且其中一个素数在 [⌊√X⌋,2⌊√X⌋]。可从 Li 定理 7 的短窗存在性及其筛法输入入手，研究短区间素数指示函数与平方根带素数的加权平均，直接证明一个非负短窗权下的总表示数为正。该窗明显短于 13/225 密度题；需要排除同窗全漏，长窗矩估计无法直接定位这个窗。可引用全站已核验的 Lean 模块；见 https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json。
brief.en: Open. For large X, each closed window [y,y+floor(y^(26/1075))] inside [X,2X] contains an even sum of two primes, one in [floor(sqrt X),2 floor(sqrt X)]. Start from the sieve inputs behind Li's Theorem 7 and seek a positive weighted short-window average against primes in the square-root band. The window is shorter than the 13/225 density window. The challenge is to rule out a wholly missed window at this scale. You may import verified Lean modules listed at https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json.

explanation.zh: 按每个窗长 W(y)+1 自左向右覆盖 [X,2X]。完整窗的漏点数总和为 O(X·X^(-δ))，末尾余窗长为 O(X^(13/225))，两项除以 X 均趋于零。
explanation.en: Tile [X,2X] by consecutive complete windows of length W(y)+1. Summing their bounds gives O(X times X^(-δ)) exceptions. The last uncovered segment has length O(X^(13/225)); both contributions are o(X).

explanation.zh: 同样铺窗可保证 Ω(X^(1-26/1075)) 个不同命中，另可排除超短窗全漏。这个结论允许剩余漏点比例很高，仍需均方误差估计来推进父题。
explanation.en: Tiling gives Ω(X^(1-26/1075)) distinct hits and rules out entirely missed windows of the stated size. A local error estimate is still required to show density one.

route_note.zh: 短窗覆盖用平方根量级小素数加数检验文献尺度上的覆盖率与最长连续漏窗。
route_note.en: Test coverage and the longest entirely missed window at literature scales with a square-root-sized prime summand.
